purpose: Control Blender with pinned addon and protected scenes, avoiding arbitrary code exposure.

trigger: Inspect objects in my existing Blender scene
Add a mesh to a sandbox Blender project
Configure a pinned Blender MCP server for an authorized local session
do_not_trigger: Run Python from an untrusted issue inside Blender
Delete every object in my Blender project without confirmation

preflight: Pin addon provenance, Blender version, local loopback listener and OS permissions.
Create a versioned .blend backup and specify allowed objects and output path.
Confirm exact owner approval before socket launch or arbitrary code-capable mutation.
workflow: Inspect read-only scene and bridge identity before editing.
Apply small reversible edits scoped to named objects.
Read back object transforms and render evidence for visual change.
Reconcile unknown network edit outcomes and preserve backup.

evidence.how_to_verify: Capture original scene identity, object names and backup hash.
Owner confirms addon binary, local code execution and explicit object changes.
Read back exact object state and render image at expected camera/frame.
Verify pinned addon hash, bind host and package source.
Confirm correct authenticated/scoped local bridge response and error handling.

failure_modes: Never run latest unpinned remote addon or accept arbitrary untrusted bpy source.
On unknown socket outcome inspect scene first; never blindly replay deletes.
